pool.text: American sea captain Arent Schuyler de Peyster first sighted Funafuti and named it.
The United States Exploring Expedition led by Charles Wilkes visited Funafuti.
Members of the US Fish Commission visited Funafuti on the USFC Albatross.
Captain Herbert Gibson declared each of the Ellice Islands a British protectorate.
Count Rudolph Festetics de Tolna and family visited Funafuti aboard a yacht.
The Royal Society of London conducted the Darwin's Drill project on Funafuti.
The first resident magistrate was appointed to the island of Funafuti.
The Funafuti Post Office officially opened around this time.
American forces occupied Funafuti during World War II as a staging ground.
Cyclone Bebe struck Funafuti, causing extensive damage across the island.
Funafuti was chosen as the administrative capital of the newly founded nation.
The United States maintained its claim until a treaty went into effect.
The Funafuti Conservation Area was established along the western rim of reef.
The Tuvalu Games were held yearly starting this year with outer island teams.
The installed PV capacity in Funafuti reached 735 kW compared to diesel.
The International Union of Geological Sciences included the atoll in heritage sites.
A general election in Tuvalu resulted in the re-election of Simon Kofe.
